subject.title: fix: preserve BOOTSTRAP.md in preseeded workspaces (#91931)

question: Should pending workspaces with `BOOTSTRAP.md` present and no `setupCompletedAt` require memory/MEMORY evidence or explicit bootstrap removal, rather than allowing profile-file differences or preseeded skills to repair completion?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes upgrade behavior for an existing bootstrap-reconciliation heuristic; source inspection cannot determine whether preserving legacy profile-diff repair is a required compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept the narrowed evidence rule
options.body: Document the rule and merge this PR so profile and preseeded-skill data cannot silently complete a pending first-run bootstrap.

options.title: Preserve legacy repair by mode
options.body: Require an explicit managed-workspace mode or migration design if profile-diff completion must remain available for existing pending workspaces.

options.title: Defer the behavior change
options.body: Keep the linked bug open until an owner chooses the long-term bootstrap completion contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed evidence rule
recommendation.body: Document the rule and merge this PR so profile and preseeded-skill data cannot silently complete a pending first-run bootstrap.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the stale-bootstrap repair behavior whose compatibility boundary the PR changes.
